fusions.name: Echo Sounding
fusions.desc: Sends a pulse into the first enemy it meets for 4 damage, then on to 1 more enemy within 3 tiles for 60% of that. Each hit has a 35% chance to leave its target [Marked] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Colony Sortie
fusions.desc: Looses 3 bats in a spread out to 6 tiles, each dealing 6 damage. 25% of the damage dealt comes back to you as healing over the following 5 seconds. Also costs 4% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Running Dark
fusions.desc: Veils you and your allies for 8 seconds: enemies notice you 60% later and you move 15% faster. The veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Feeding on Passage
fusions.desc: After you cover enough ground, your attacks heal you for 20% of the damage they deal for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
